---
name: Bug report
description: Report reproducible cross-platform app, widget, data or import bugs
labels: bug
---

Describe expected vs actual behavior, steps to reproduce and whether it concerns **Android or iOS** (include OS version, device, widget family/launcher, Apex Companion version, `LIVE/STALE/DEMO/MANUAL` status and last update time). Include sanitized logs/screenshots only with permission. Do not share API keys, private UIDs or copyrighted art.
